about: Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, supplies, and trades in aroma and fragrance chemicals in India and internationally. The company offers aroma chemicals, including alpha damascone, alpha ionone, alpha terpenyl acetate, amber fleur, amber gamma, ambery woody extreme, beta iso damascol, bi perfumery and technical grades, camphor, carene, carvacrol, cedar ketol, cineole, citronellal, citronellol, citronellyl acetate and nitrile, cyclademol, cyclamen a
